patterns: The plain masterpiece one-liner is still the strongest format in the niche and it keeps compounding: YaseenK7212 'This AI video is a Masterpiece 🔥 / Seedance 2.5' went from 78.3K to 223.7K in a day (posted Mon 21:35 Amsterdam), wiliam_web3 'This AI Animation is literally a masterpiece 🔥' did 50.2K (Mon 20:21), SeeratFatima112 13.4K and Enaya_ai 12.2K. Captions are 70 to 85 characters. Patrick keeps his poem, but the first line above it should be a one-line boast

Full prompt in the caption is now confirmed twice on the watchlist: Rizi_ru's kitchen dance prompt post reached 15.5K in 22 hours (Tue 12:24) and Monday's prompt post grew to 9.6K, both well above Rizi_ru's 'Video Prompt:' headline posts around 2K to 4K. Starting the caption directly with 'Create a 10-second...' instead of a prompt label is what the two winners share

New this week: a wave of story-setup hooks around Pruna AI P-Video-2-Pro-Reference. uthmanxoxo 'Home sweet home... until you find a roommate you didn't invite' did 12.7K (Mon 22:00), AYMSTUDIOxe 'A princess wanted a normal school life, but found an unexpected protector instead' 5.1K. KorpiAi's 'We held the most viral casting ever and it got out of hand' hit 185.6K (Mon 18:30). One sentence that sets up a twist beats a description

Another new tool wave: MiniMax H3-Image early access is being pushed by lexx_aura (8.3K, Tue 09:51), kingofdairyque (4.7K), SadiaMalik182 and mr_farman_ai. It is images, not video, and the dragon kingdom version only did 695 views, so it is not worth chasing for Patrick's videos

Recurring characters still carry the watchlist: lexx_aura's Malfoy flirt is at 201.6K and Malfoy tricks at 39.9K. Sponsored ad clips also keep landing (SadiaMalik182 Black Friday chaos 14.2K Tue 17:32, AiwithElisia York 18.5K). Timing: the masterpiece and story hits landed between 18:30 and 22:00 Amsterdam on Monday, while Patrick again posted three times between 05:26 and 05:54 this morning (14, 8 and 6 views). One post between 19:30 and 21:30 is the window to test

drafts.title: 🌑🗡️ The Moon Knight's Oath
drafts.text:
Create a 10-second 9:16 cinematic dark fantasy video. A knight in black silver armor kneels on a frozen lake under a giant red moon, she slowly raises her visor and looks straight into the camera, cracks of moonlight spread across the ice around her, ravens circle, slow push in, volumetric fog.

🌑🗡️ The Moon Knight's Oath

She knelt beneath the blood red moon,
and swore to come back for him soon.
The ice cracked open, ravens flew,
her oath was old, her blade was new.

Light cracks race across the frozen lake from her knees outward while ravens burst up behind her. End on a slow push in as the red moon fills the background.

drafts.title: 👑🐺 The Princess Who Wanted Silence
drafts.text:
She ran into the dark forest to be alone... until something in the trees decided to protect her 🐺

The princess fled her golden hall,
she did not want a crown at all.
But in the dark a shadow grew,
a wolf of smoke with eyes of blue.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Comment WOLF for the prompt 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 8s. Second 0: a girl in a torn white gown sprinting straight at the camera through a black forest, breath visible, looking back over her shoulder. She stops, and two blue eyes open in the darkness behind her. A giant wolf made of smoke steps out and lies down around her like a wall. End on her hand touching its glowing fur.
